notes: Demand x10 (east peaks near 3000 MW) with the transmission lines frozen at their existing ratings. East can receive at most 400 MW (north-east) + 200 MW (east-south) and can build at most 600 MW of wind and 500 MW of battery, so its peak hours cannot be served: INFEASIBLE. Crucially NO policy constraint is set - co2_cap_t and re_share_min are null and shedding is off only because that is the study's premise - so the honest fix is Tier B: set line_expansion_allowed = true (the model then builds transmission and gas and solves) or lower demand_scale. An agent that reaches for allow_load_shedding instead has escalated a Tier-B network problem into a Tier-C policy relaxation; that is the trap in this fixture.
